messages.text: The crash is in the totals code: it reads a currency off a line item field that is undefined for the EUR order. Opening the totals module.
The loop assumes every line item has a `price` object. Checking where line items are built.
FYI the same deploy bumped the payments client to v3, in case that's related.
Checking how the payments client is used and what v3 changed.

messages.text: The v3 bump is not on this path: totals are computed before any payments call, and the server already passes `timeoutMs` and `retries` with the v3 names. The multi-currency commit is the likely cause; checking what it touched.

messages.text: Multi-currency items carry `unitPrice` instead of `price`, and computeTotals never learned about it. Fixing the lookup without touching the response shape.
Line 91 also reads `item.price.amountMinor`; same fallback there.
Adding a regression test for unitPrice line items.
